verdict.rationale: Ollama documents a native REST API for running and managing models, plus Python and JavaScript libraries and curl-based quickstarts for local and cloud use, so its core functions are API-accessible. The newer desktop app exposes features like the Apps connection flow for Claude and ChatGPT, and nothing documents those or other UI features through the API. The OpenAI-compatible layer is explicitly only a subset. missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement, API coverage of app-only features such as Apps connections, a published OpenAPI spec (probes returned 404), independent corroboration of parity.
